what: A picture board stuck behind the screen swaps to a different image for each section (data-bg-section). Following a three-layer sine wave pattern (periods 10·8·16), the outgoing image is pushed to the upper left and the incoming one to the lower right (strength .45) as they blend and melt over 1.6s power2.inOut. The first section switches at the top edge of the screen, the rest when the section head touches 75% of the screen (scrolling back up returns to the previous image). On first open it enters from the board’s background color to the first image with the same wave. Images are scaled to cover the screen and aligned left

options.sections: Section selector for swapping images, default [data-bg-section] — scenes 0, 1, 2 … in document order
options.start: Start line from the second section on, default top 75%
options.--fx-bg: Background color before the image (via style), default --kf-contrast-bg
options.[data-fx-part=scene]: One scene (required, in order) — contains one img, canvas or svg. SVG is baked at viewBox size
